paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.49% on average, with Nasdaq strongest (+1.11%) and DAX weakest (-1.18%). Brent crude changed +0.22% to 109.79. Gold changed +0.07% to 4,162.8999. Bitcoin changed -0.03% to 81,996.2031. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.136%, a relative move of +0.75%. Among the firms tracked, EQT (+3.33%) and Deutsche Bank (-2.89%) moved the most.
